purpose: Track where benchmark and capability evidence came from so Buddy's scores remain auditable and reproducible.
rules: Do not represent a source's material as DreamCo-owned merely because Buddy observed it.
Record applicable license, terms, attribution, and usage basis before redistribution.
Keep source evidence distinct from DreamCo-created derivatives.
Preserve enough metadata to reproduce a benchmark result.
Do not use provenance metadata to make unsupported ownership claims.
audit_goal: Every material benchmark claim should be traceable to its evidence and transformation history.
